issues.description: Method getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): the UML class diagram in problem_statement.md declares getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() with a void return type, but the textual task description and the provided solution implement and expect this method to return a String. Specifically, the textual requirements state the method should return a String in the format "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)" (problem_statement.md line 44), while the UML lists the method as returning void (problem_statement.md line 71). The solution implements public String getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 80). This contradiction between UML and text/solution will confuse students about the correct return type to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String so it matches the textual description and the solution implementation. Optionally add a short clarifying note in the problem statement (near the method description) that the method should return a String of the form "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)" to avoid further ambiguity.
